description: This script detects and executes a specified tool using available package managers (pnpm, bun, npm, npx). It ensures the correct environment is used based on the presence of lock files and command availability, providing a fallback and an error message if no suitable package manager is found.

methods.name: main logic of script, starting from line 3
methods.description: Sets strict error handling and defines root directory; handles command-line arguments; detects package managers and executes the tool accordingly; prints error if none are available.
